references.text: Warns that the foreign peoples will lead the Israelites to sin against the Lord by following their gods
Prohibition against making a covenant with the peoples in the land, because they will lead Israel into idolatry
Explains that the foreign peoples will turn the children of Israel away from the Lord to serve other gods
Warning against following the abominations of the foreign peoples in their worship of gods
List of abominations practiced by the people of Canaan, which Israel was not to imitate
Joshua's warning against mixing with the remaining peoples and following their gods
The Lord's judgment on Israel because they did not drive out the peoples, and their gods became a snare for them
Solomon's heart was turned away from the Lord by his foreign wives to follow other gods
The Israelites had not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands and their abominations
Israel mixed with the peoples and learned their deeds, and their idols became a snare for them
